paragraphs: GraphAware is a global team of graph and engineering experts building an approach to intelligence analysis. Its platform, GraphAware Hume, turns siloed data into a connected intelligence picture so analysts can answer their hardest questions.

Data from separate sources is brought into a connected view structured the way the organisation itself understands it. Analysts then navigate and query that data to find hidden relationships, follow lines of enquiry, and see the patterns that matter. One published case study describes a national security cyber-defense agency that needed to connect, integrate and navigate data.
The clients described span law enforcement agencies, cyber defence advisories, and financial authorities around the world. The company was established in 2013.

quote.text: It’s the result of more than a decade spent helping law enforcement and security organisations make sense of complex connections
